name: Moderation and Quarantine
summary: Classifies uploads and text for abuse, and quarantines by default so unreviewed content is never served.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Branch connection string. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
env.description: Object Storage endpoint. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Object Storage access key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_STORAGE_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Object Storage secret key. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: NEON_AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY
env.description: AI Gateway credential. Injected automatically by Neon.

env.name: MODERATION_QUARANTINE_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix quarantined objects move to. Must be disjoint from the watched prefix, or moving an object retriggers moderation of itself.

env.name: MODERATION_THRESHOLDS
env.description: Per-category block thresholds as JSON, e.g. {"adult":0.5,"violence":0.7}. Strict by default: permissive defaults create a false belief that content was checked.

env.name: NEON_BLOCKS_TRIGGER_SECRET
env.description: Shared secret authenticating trigger delivery. Neon does not sign trigger POSTs.

triggers.description: Required by §5, and load-bearing here: an object the trigger missed stays quarantined, so a missed delivery is a stuck upload rather than unmoderated content.

operations.title: GET /health
operations.description: Liveness and readiness, backed by the block's v_status view.
